name: keep_in_mind
description: Store a short note or reminder context from the user for future reference. Only call after user confirmation.

what.description: The core content of the reminder/note.

user_confirmed.description: Must be set to true only after the user has explicitly confirmed the content of the reminder/note.

name: create_activity
description: Create a new activity/task from the user's request. Always confirm all details with the user before calling.

summary.description: The main title or summary of the activity.

dtstart.description: The start date and time of the activity in Persian (Jalali) calendar format, e.g., '1405-01-01T12:00'. This will be internally converted to a standard datetime format.

description.description: Optional detailed description for the activity.

is_recurrent.description: Set to true if the activity repeats on a schedule, false otherwise. If true, `rrule` must be provided.

rrule.description: The recurrence rule in RRULE format (RFC 5545). Only required if `is_recurrent` is true.

rrule_human.description: A human-readable description of the recurrence rule (e.g., 'every day', 'every Monday'). This is for informational purposes and may be used to confirm with the user.

user_confirmed.description: Must be set to true only after the user has explicitly confirmed all the details (summary, date, description, recurrence, etc.) for the action.

name: edit_activity
description: Edit an existing activity/task by its ID. Only call after user confirmation.

activity_id.description: The unique identifier of the activity to be edited.

new_summary.description: The new title or summary for the activity.

new_dtstart.description: The new start date and time in Persian (Jalali) calendar format (e.g., '1405-01-01T12:00'). This will be internally converted.

new_description.description: The new detailed description for the activity.

make_recurrent.description: Set to true to make the activity recurrent, or false to make it a single event. If set to true, `new_rrule` must be provided.

new_rrule.description: The new recurrence rule in RRULE format. Only required if `make_recurrent` is true.

new_rrule_human.description: A human-readable description of the new recurrence rule (e.g., 'every Tuesday').

user_confirmed.description: Must be set to true only after the user has explicitly confirmed all the changes.

name: report_activities_by_time
description: Retrieve time-based or status-based activity reports (e.g., today's activities, overdue tasks). Only call after user confirmation.

name: report_activities_by_summary
description: Search for activities matching a keyword in their summary and return a list of those activities. Use this when the user wants a list of activities based on a search term.

summary_keyword.description: The keyword or phrase to search for within the summaries of activities. This can be a partial match. Max length 200 characters.

name: show_activity_detail
description: Retrieve the full, detailed information for a single, specific activity identified by its exact or partial title. Use this when the user asks to view all details of one particular activity, and it is expected to return details for one specific task.

activity_title.description: The exact or partial title of the specific activity for which detailed information is requested.

name: end_conversation
description: End the current conversation and stop the bot flow. Only call after user confirmation.

reason.description: Optional reason for ending the conversation (e.g., 'user request complete', 'user ended conversation').

user_confirmed.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly confirms ending the conversation.
